segments.source: Solution
segments.normalizedSource: Solution
segments.contextAfter: Use the `pthread_once(_:_:)` function to initialize a mutex before you use it.

segments.source: Use the `pthread_once(_:_:)` function to initialize a mutex before you use it.
segments.normalizedSource: Use the `pthread_once(_:_:)` function to initialize a mutex before you use it.
segments.contextBefore: Solution

segments.normalizedSource: ```occ static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT; static pthread_mutex_t mutex; void init() { pthread_mutex_init(&mutex, NULL); } void performWork() { pthread_once(&once, init); // Correct pthread_mutex_lock(&mutex); // ... pthread_mutex_unlock(&mutex); } ```
segments.contextBefore: Use the `pthread_once(_:_:)` function to initialize a mutex before you use it.
